title: 동기적으로 적응적인 컴퓨터 보조수업: 개념과 미래 방향

abstracts.value:
Learners' motivation changes during their learning with computer-assisted instruction. However, it is quite recent that some efforts have been made to design and develop CAI which is adaptive to learners' motivational change. The efforts to provide more individualized instruction and the efforts to design more motivating CAI are now heading in the same direction toward designing a motivationally adaptive CAI.
The purposes of this article are to introduce the idea of motivationally adaptive computer-assisted instruction(MACAI) and to present the issues to be solved in order to develop a functioning protytype. The following four issues are pointed out.
1. Need for practical definition of motivation to learn.
2. Measuring motivation to learn.
3. Comprehensive list of motivational strategies.
4. An integrated model validated in theory and practice.
